name: Cordelia
source:
Very close to her younger twin sister Yunia. Doesn't always know how to make friends, but is open to making new acquaintances and having fun, supports any crazy idea or prank. Dreams of opening a bakery that serves everything with strawberries.

[From the in-game description]
